description: Northampton County government key events timeline

records.title: County Council personnel committee reviews Zrinski appointments
Zrinski announces Cabinet picks
records.details: Sheriff Zieger, Coroner Lysek reappointed; Mark Aurand named Admin Director; DeAnn Lawrence named Corrections Director

records.title: Tara Zrinski sworn in as County Executive
records.details: First woman to serve as Northampton County Executive

records.title: County Council passes $503M 2026 budget
records.details: 7-2 vote; 8th consecutive year no tax increase

records.title: Tara Zrinski wins County Executive election
records.details: Defeated Republican Giovanni

records.title: Learning Locomotion childcare center opens at Gracedale
records.details: On-site childcare for healthcare workers

records.title: Fiscal Affairs Director Stephen Barron departs
records.details: Leaves for CFO role at Workforce Board Lehigh Valley after 7 years

records.title: McClure proposes 2026 budget at Gracedale
records.details: $503M budget with no tax increase

records.title: Christopher Zieger appointed Sheriff
records.details: Following Richard Johnston retirement

records.title: Donate Life Month ceremony at Forensic Center
records.details: Coroner Lysek participates with Gift of Life Donor Program

records.title: Tara Zrinski sworn in as Controller
Stephen Baratta sworn in as District Attorney
Zrinski defeats Cusick for Controller; Baratta wins DA
DA Terry Houck drops reelection bid
records.details: Withdrew due to campaign expense concerns

records.title: Scott Parsons appointed interim Controller
records.details: Following Szulborski death

records.title: Controller Richard 'Bucky' Szulborski dies
records.details: Former Bethlehem city council member; served as controller twice

records.title: Stephen Baratta defeats Terry Houck in DA Democratic primary
County Council raises Controller salary to $85,000
records.details: Unanimous vote; $10,000 increase effective Jan 2024

records.title: Deputy sheriffs complain to County Council
records.details: Concerns about staffing and morale under Sheriff Johnston

records.title: Controller Antoine 'Tony' Bassil dies
records.details: Served less than 2 years; Szulborski reappointed

records.title: COVID-19 pandemic begins affecting county operations
Terry Houck sworn in as District Attorney
records.details: First new DA in 28 years; succeeded John Morganelli

records.title: Tony Bassil sworn in as Controller
John Morganelli elected county judge
records.details: Ending 28-year tenure as DA (1992-2019)

records.title: Richard Johnston confirmed as Sheriff
records.details: 8-0 council vote; replaced David Dalrymple

records.title: Stephen Barron becomes Fiscal Affairs Director
records.details: Resigned as Controller to join McClure administration

records.title: Zachary Lysek appointed Coroner
records.details: Appointed by County Executive Gerald Seyfried
